programme.desc: S3 E18 — Mission: Bus RideDisability assistance dog Tinks needs all her super fetch skills and big dog energy as she helps Charli catch a bus to meet her friend Lydia, who is getting married.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: S2 E28 — Aneeshwar and Lizzie: Tenrec and TarantulaAneeshwar and Lizzie meet a tenrec and a tarantula.

programme.title: What's in Your Bag?
programme.desc: S2 E3 — Bhangra DancerBhangra dancer Jas explains why she loves to wear her pretty parandi in her hair when she's dancing at special events.

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Waffle's MagicMrs Hobbs thinks she has magicked Waffle the Wonder Dog away, but Waffle is on an adventure of his own, sniffing for a biscuit backstage.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Night LightsOona makes her first night-time trip to the sea - all on her own!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: S1 E32 — Water MusicSonny organises a tea party in his caravan to show off his new musical instrument, but rain pours through his leaky roof. While his plans for a musical afternoon seem like a washout, the gang may find another use for all those rain-filled bottles.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: S1 E31 — Find the BlueberriesLu and Biba find toy blueberries at playtime and decide to play a treasure hunt game. When Declan joins the game, he realises that they rigged it.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: S1 E41 — Bunny BabysittingFiona has to babysit the Bunnies, but they're bouncing off the walls! She calls the Piggies for help, but even they find this task impossible.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: S2 E13 — The Two TreeThe Numberblocks find a magic Two Tree and play an action-packed game of throwing twos. Learn all about adding and taking away in twos with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: S2 E17 — LipsIt is bedtime for A, E, I, O and U, but vowels will be vowels and there is no getting them to snuggle down. L's lullaby usually does the trick, but she needs a little help from her friends.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S14 E3 — We're All Friends: Let's Go CampingBen and his friends are in the forest, while Mr Tumble gets into a muddle pitching a tent.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S2 E42 — WashingPo eats Tubby Custard and gets a messy bib. Po washes the bib clean and hangs it out to dry before eating more Tubby Custard with Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: S1 E3 — AcornsRanger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how acorns play an important role in the environment. They find out how tiny acorns can grow into giant oak trees that live for hundreds of years and that acorns are a great food source for animals like squirrels who bury them to eat in winter. On the way, they spot a woodpecker's nest in an oak tree and learn that oak trees support more life than any other tree in the UK - all thanks to the tiny acorn.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: S2 E5 — Opticians & GlassesMaddie is finding out how wearing glasses help to see more clearly. She visits an optician to see how an eye test works by having one herself. She reads the charts and shapes on the wall and looks into a special camera.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: S1 E16 — Three-Wheeled MachinesGrace the motorbike rider shows off three amazing machines that only have three wheels. Grace drives a three-wheeled sports car, shows off an unusual three-wheeled tractor and then rides a three-wheeled motorbike.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: S4 E19 — Remembrance AssemblyIt's a special day at school as the children take part in a Remembrance assembly. Leon and Jud make a handprint poppy wreath with help from Year 6 pupil Hania.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S2 E12 — Fiddler CrabsThe Octonauts help clean up a beach after a storm, but things get complicated when the resident fiddler crabs hijack the Gup-D.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S3 — The Tale of the Sleepy HedgehogPeter volunteers to take Mrs Tiggy-Winkle home in time for her winter hibernation, but little does he know how much trouble a sleepy hedgehog can be!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S3 E5 — The Get Indoors BadgeA severe weather warning from Duggee's barometer leads the Squirrels to round up all the creatures they can find outside and pile into the clubhouse for an impromptu party, earning their Get Indoors badges in the process.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: S1 E27 — Tip of the TongueNugget arranges an ice-sculpting event, but only Flutter turns up. However, when his tongue gets accidentally stuck to the ice, it takes the whole colony to solve the problem.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: S2 E8 — Carrot's Big TopCarrot takes the spotlight in her circus and believes Supertato is trying to steal her limelight. Eventually, she realises Supertato's actions aim to rescue her from Evil Pea's interference.

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: S1 E69 — Mission CircusWeasy and the girls have found a circus trunk and are having fun with the things inside it. The chipmunk makes fun of the Weasy family and their ridiculous antics.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E43 — It Came from Planet BoogieMojo and Bo need to move a crashed meteor. But every time Mojo goes near the big rock, moving turns to grooving. How can you move a meteor if you can't stop dancing?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E4 — PromisesBluey keeps breaking her promises, but after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it is important not to break them.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E39 — Double BabysitterWhen Uncle Rad and Frisky accidentally turn up to babysit Bluey and Bingo on the same night, they have to work together to make Bluey feel better about babysitter put-downs.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E21 — Bump on the NogginGadabout forgets he is a doctor, returning to his knightly ways.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Plant PanicWith the harbour master away, Penny Pocket tends to his beloved pet plant, Colin - she must get him better!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Training WaffleEvie, Doug, Jess and Gramps take Waffle to his first puppy training class. Waffle can't resist causing chaos. Simon stays at home to look for his missing sock.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: The More Than One WishRuby wants to know what would happen if Rafi wished for more wishes. The friends find out.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: S3 E30 — Autumn: It's Time to Write a BookJoJo and Gran Gran are at the library trying to find a new Captain Chloe book, but it seems that she's read them all. JoJo asks Terrence the librarian if there's a book about Captain Chloe and pandas. Unfortunately, Terrence isn't sure there is one.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: S1 E19 — Coloured LightSarah and Duck are sitting and eating sweets when Sarah is inspired to create a colourful art project after seeing the colourful glow of a rainbow.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: S2 E7 — The Disappearing NestThe Iron Chicken invites the Wols to supper, and goes to fetch some blue string pudding from the Clangers. When she gets back home, she finds her nest has disappeared.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: S1 E45 — HelpingMeMo and BaBa help their friends on Planet BeddyByes.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Slow Down EverybodyThe Tombliboos are playing their music so fast that everybody does everything very fast too. Igglepiggle and Upsy Daisy dance, and Makka Pakka washes stones until at last, the Tombliboos slow down.

programme.title: Cbeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: S2022 E820 — Sue Perkins - The Pirate MumsSue Perkins tells the tale of the Pirate Mums who save the day on the high seas.

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Magnificent Monuments
programme.desc: Houses and PalacesThis film celebrates the grandeur of Hampton Court Palace and visits Cragside, one of the first homes to have electric lighting. Fred Dibnah also examines restoration work on a 15th century manor house.

programme.title: War Walks
programme.desc: S1 E2 — WaterlooWellington's victory against Napoleon in 1815 ended the most powerful European empire since the Romans. Professor Holmes visits the farms and fields where history hung in the balance.

programme.title: My Garden of a Thousand Bees
programme.desc: Wildlife film-maker Martin Dohrn is bee obsessed. He has found over 60 species in his Bristol garden, from giant bumblebees to scissor bees the size of a mosquito, which he films with mind-blowing results. Dohrn can identify individual insects and forms a remarkable relationship with one leaf-cutter bee he follows through its entire life.

programme.title: Building Sights
programme.desc: The Katharine Stephen RoomArchitect James Stirling examines the Katharine Stephen Room, a rare books library at Newnham College, Cambridge, built in 1981-1982 to the designs of Joanna van Heyningen and Birkin Haward.

Raised in the freezing outer reaches of the solar system Saturn began life as a strange planet of rock and ice.

programme.title: Remembers...

programme.title: The Wednesday Play
programme.desc: Cathy Come HomeLandmark 1960s TV play about a young couple and their children who are cruelly overtaken by events which lead them into an unrelenting trap of debt, homelessness and poverty.

programme.title: A Wild Year
programme.desc: S1 E1 — The Pembrokeshire CoastIn the far south-west corner of Wales lies Pembrokeshire's wild and rugged coast. Twisting and turning along the edge of the Atlantic, life on this ancient coastline is defined by the rhythm of the seasons and the power of the sea. Fishing these fertile waters has long been a tradition here. Every day, local fisherman Jono Voyce heads out from Solva harbour into St Brides Bay to fish for the lobster and crab he supplies to these coastal communities.

programme.desc: S3 E5 — OmeletteBingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Hannah Montana: The Movie
programme.desc: As her pop starlet alter-ego Hannah Montana's fame begins to grow, teenager Miley Stewart gets carried away with the success and is sent to work on the family farm in Tennessee. With help from her faithful friends, she begins to discover who she really is and what is important in life. Family comedy, starring real-life father and daughter Miley and Billy Ray Cyrus, alongside Emily Osment, Jason Earles and Mitchel Musso.

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: A lonely boy uses electricity to bring his dead dog back to life. However, the presence of the animal in the neighbourhood leads to panic over a monster, while the young scientist's classmates are soon also meddling with life and death to revive their own pets. Tim Burton's stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Charlie Tahan and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: A doting dad is taken aback when his daughter announces she is getting married, and is thrown into a whirlwind of increasingly complicated wedding plans, a struggle to live up to the expectations of his wealthy future in-laws and the sad realisation that his little girl has grown up. Remake of the 1950s comedy, with Steve Martin, Diane Keaton, Kimberly Williams and Martin Short.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: The four Pevensie children are summoned back to the magical land of Narnia to find centuries have passed in their absence. War is now brewing, and the young heroes must help Prince Caspian, the rightful king of Narnia, to overthrow his cruel uncle and reclaim the throne. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Ben Barnes, William Moseley, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell and Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: Lilo & Stitch
programme.desc: A lonely little girl befriends a runaway alien that helps mend her fractured family. Live action fantasy adventure, starring Maia Kealoha and Sydney Agudong.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: The struggling owner of a run-down gym is forced to take drastic action to prevent an arrogant fitness guru buying the business out from under him - and enlists his customers to form a dodgeball team in the hope of triumphing in the US championships. Sporting comedy, starring Ben Stiller, Vince Vaughn and Christine Taylor.

programme.title: Juno
programme.desc: A teenage girl finds herself pregnant after a one-night stand with her best friend. Deciding to give her baby up for adoption, she thinks she has found the perfect parents in a yuppie couple. However, over the next nine months she begins to experience doubts about her plans. Comedy, starring Elliot Page, Michael Cera, Jennifer Garner and Jason Bateman.

programme.title: The Wild
programme.desc: The son of a lion kept in a zoo in Central Park is crated up and shipped to Africa. His worried father musters a band of fellow creatures and escapes from captivity in a quest to rescue the youngster. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Kiefer Sutherland, James Belushi, Eddie Izzard, Janeane Garofalo and William Shatner.

programme.title: Eternals
programme.desc: When monstrous entities called Deviants infest the Earth in 5000 BC Mesopotamia, an ancient race of beings known as Celestials, led by the mighty Arishem, fashion humanity's superpowered protectors, the Eternals. For more than 7,000 years, this band of near-immortal saviours live among us, in plain sight but unseen. They are instructed not to interfere in human conflicts unless Deviants are involved, and watch with dismay as humans resolve differences with bloodshed. Sci-fi adventure from Marvel Studios, starring Gemma Chan, Richard Madden, Angelina Jolie and Salma Hayek.

programme.title: Young Woman and the Sea
programme.desc: Through the steadfast support of her older sister and supportive trainers, Trudy Ederle overcomes adversity to rise through the ranks of the Olympic swimming team. She then attempts to become the first woman to successfully swim the English Channel. Drama, starring Daisy Ridley and Stephen Graham.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Joining a spaceship crew, he embarks on a perilous journey in search of the loot - unaware that the vessel's cyborg cook is planning a mutiny. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: The four Pevensie children are summoned back to the magical land of Narnia to find centuries have passed in their absence. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: Tarzan
programme.desc: A man raised by gorillas in the jungle has his first encounter with humans in the form of a scientist and his daughter, and is torn between remaining among the apes or rediscovering his roots. He must also fight to defend his animal friends from a big-game hunter. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tony Goldwyn and Minnie Driver.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas
programme.desc: Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King of Halloween Town, tires of being scary and decides to take over the friendly world of Christmas. After kidnapping Santa, he prepares to take his place and do Christmas in his own ghoulish way. Stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Chris Sarandon, Catherine O'Hara and Paul Reubens, and a musical score by Danny Elfman.

programme.title: The Proposal
programme.desc: A Canadian publishing editor working in New York faces deportation to her own country. Desperate to stay in America, she offers her assistant a promotion if he will marry her, but an immigration official becomes suspicious and the pair are forced to go to desperate lengths to look like a happy couple. Romantic comedy, starring Sandra Bullock and Ryan Reynolds.

programme.title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
programme.desc: An eccentric marine expert sets out in search of a legendary shark that ate his old friend and shipmate. Unfortunately the voyage is riddled with problems, including a man claiming to be his long-lost son, a pursuing pirate crew and a rival oceanographer. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Bill Murray, Owen Wilson, Cate Blanchett, Willem Dafoe and Jeff Goldblum.

programme.title: Tomorrowland: A World Beyond
programme.desc: A boy genius in the 1960s finds his way into a spectacular futuristic metropolis while attempting to promote his idea for a jetpack. Decades later, he has grown into a disillusioned adult, while a girl who has the talent and enthusiasm he has lost also finds her way into this strange new world, and together they attempt to uncover its secrets. Fantasy adventure inspired by the theme park, starring George Clooney, Britt Robertson and Hugh Laurie.

Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: The four Pevensie children are summoned back to the magical land of Narnia to find centuries have passed in their absence. War is now brewing, and the young heroes must help Prince Caspian, the rightful king of Narnia, to overthrow his cruel uncle and reclaim the throne. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Ben Barnes, William Moseley, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell and Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: Maleficent
programme.desc: A fairy falls in love with an ambitious human nobleman, who betrays her in pursuit of claiming the throne. She swears to get revenge on him by placing a curse on his daughter, only to find herself developing a maternal bond with the girl. Fantasy adventure based on the story of Sleeping Beauty, starring Angelina Jolie, Elle Fanning, Sharlto Copley and Imelda Staunton.

programme.title: Cool Runnings
programme.desc: A sprinter fails to qualify for the Jamaican Olympic squad, but refuses to give up his dream. Learning that a former US bobsleigh coach is living nearby, he seizes the chance to shine in an entirely different sport, and cajoles three of his friends to join him in training for the 1988 Winter Olympics in the far less tropical environment of Canada. Fact-based comedy, with John Candy, Leon, Doug E Doug and Malik Yoba.

programme.title: The Heat
programme.desc: An uptight, ambitious FBI agent is sent to Boston to bring a notorious drug kingpin to justice. She ends up forced to team up with a rebellious, foul-mouthed local police detective who has a very different attitude to law enforcement but shares her inability to work with others. Action comedy, starring Sandra Bullock and Melissa McCarthy.

programme.title: Juno
programme.desc: A teenage girl finds herself pregnant after a one-night stand with her best friend. Deciding to give her baby up for adoption, she thinks she has found the perfect parents in a yuppie couple. However, over the next nine months she begins to experience doubts about her plans. Comedy, starring Elliot Page, Michael Cera, Jennifer Garner and Jason Bateman.

programme.title: Eternals
programme.desc: When monstrous entities called Deviants infest the Earth in 5000 BC Mesopotamia, an ancient race of beings known as Celestials, led by the mighty Arishem, fashion humanity's superpowered protectors, the Eternals. For more than 7,000 years, this band of near-immortal saviours live among us, in plain sight but unseen. They are instructed not to interfere in human conflicts unless Deviants are involved, and watch with dismay as humans resolve differences with bloodshed. Sci-fi adventure from Marvel Studios, starring Gemma Chan, Richard Madden, Angelina Jolie and Salma Hayek.

programme.title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
programme.desc: An eccentric marine expert sets out in search of a legendary shark that ate his old friend and shipmate. Unfortunately the voyage is riddled with problems, including a man claiming to be his long-lost son, a pursuing pirate crew and a rival oceanographer. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Bill Murray, Owen Wilson, Cate Blanchett, Willem Dafoe and Jeff Goldblum.

programme.title: Peter Pan
programme.desc: The adventures of the boy who never grows old, as he whisks Wendy Darling and her brothers away to the magical world of Neverland - where they come face to face with fearsome Captain Hook. Adaptation of JM Barrie's fantasy novel, starring Jeremy Sumpter, Rachel Hurd-Wood, Jason Isaacs and Lynn Redgrave.

programme.title: Hannah Montana: The Movie
programme.desc: As her pop starlet alter-ego Hannah Montana's fame begins to grow, teenager Miley Stewart gets carried away with the success and is sent to work on the family farm in Tennessee. With help from her faithful friends, she begins to discover who she really is and what is important in life. Family comedy, starring real-life father and daughter Miley and Billy Ray Cyrus, alongside Emily Osment, Jason Earles and Mitchel Musso.
